svg.title: Nyx Kit final logo
svg.desc: The finished folded-ribbon logo on light and dark backgrounds, plus full-colour and monochrome samples at actual display sizes.
svg.text: Aligned NYX letterforms. Refined purple surfaces. One clear silhouette.
40-unit ribbons / rounded inner fold / restrained depth
Full colour from 48 px; monochrome preferred at 24–32 px.
BASED ON D1 / ALL EXPLORATION STUDIES PRESERVED
